basic_info.description: Starter Dream! Welcome to this charming 3-story single-family home featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms in the highly desirable Central Sunset neighborhood. The kitchen and bathrooms have been tastefully updated, while the living room highlights an original fireplace and a formal dining room with high ceilings. Fresh paint and beautifully refinished hardwood floors shine throughout the second floor. Ideally located near Golden Gate Park, UCSF Medical Center, public transit, shops, restaurants, parks, and schools, this home offers both convenience and comfort. An excellent opportunity and value in one of San Francisco's most sought-after locations!
